description: γ-4g prefix-event matching — `<transition event="foo.*">` and space-separated `<transition event="foo bar">` lower through `_event_name_matches(descriptor, str(event))`, a W3C SCXML 3.13 token-prefix matcher (trailing `.*` is spec sugar, space-separated descriptors OR). The exact single-token fast path `event == Event.X` is untouched so existing goldens stay byte-stable; only documents that actually use prefix or multi-event descriptors take the new code path.
